race.comment: LADY TORQUE (7) brings the strongest exposed form, having finished third in the G3 WA Sires Produce Stakes after keeping on in the G2 Karrakatta Plate, and her two trials, including a close second, suggest she is forward enough to run well fresh. PROFIT MOTIVE (10) was slow away and steadied on debut at this track yet still made ground to be beaten just under two lengths. Has trialled strongly coming into this and the stable is flying at the moment. Keep safe. NO SHOW (6) was held up late when beaten just under a length on debut at Northam, so with that race experience he has a clear platform to improve into a winning threat. CRYPTO FORTUNE (13) won't be far away on debut.
